name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task's second sentence, 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands', is not captured. The only clause is ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which handles the fall-pickup rule correctly, but the exit condition is missing. Add a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) — at_exit is only a condition of the 'if', so no Existence(at_exit).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard captures 'make your very next move the one that picks it back up', and Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard captures 'if you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands' as an 'if' rule with no goal on at_exit; the rule-only warning is valid.
